title: Reduce rename label WebView flat exports
summary: Reduced the Rename label flat WebView export surface by removing four shared label aliases and four duplicate Rename view re-exports while preserving namespace-backed label rendering.
reason: Continue the WebView flat-export cleanup workstream with a label-only Rename-domain slice that does not change rename route payloads, apply behavior, confirmations, or filesystem mutation policy.
behavior_before: Rename label helpers were available through mediaPipelineRenameLabels and also as flat window aliases from both renameLabels.js and renameView.js.
behavior_after: Rename label helpers are consumed through mediaPipelineRenameLabels, and the four shared label helpers are no longer exported as flat aliases by renameLabels.js or renameView.js.
rollback_plan: Restore the removed rename label flat window assignments and duplicate Rename view re-exports, then regenerate the WebView public contract and summaries.
notes:
WebView flat export total moved from 820 to 812; files with flat aliases moved from 62 to 61. This is a frontend label-surface cleanup only; no backend routes, strict confirmation handling, source-media handling, pending-publish policy, command journal behavior, or rename apply mutation behavior changed.
